title: English foundations pilot (draft)
learnerEntryAssumption: A Malay-interface learner who has not yet completed a reviewed Spark Lingo English course.
purpose: Internal engineering and editorial-review pilot only. It is not a published course, CEFR level, exam-preparation product, or evidence of learning outcomes.

objectives.canDo: Use a basic English greeting in a supported practice prompt.
objectives.evidence: Select and type an accepted greeting in the reviewed exercise.

objectives.canDo: Give a short English name introduction using the provided pattern.
objectives.evidence: Produce the approved model sentence in typed recall.

objectives.canDo: Recognise an appropriate response to a basic greeting.
objectives.evidence: Choose the accepted response from supplied alternatives.

objectives.canDo: Use a basic English closing in a supported practice prompt.
objectives.evidence: Type an accepted closing in the reviewed exercise.

units.title: Greetings and introductions
units.description: A text-only, internal draft slice for the first review workflow.

lessons.title: Say hello
lessons.description: Recognise and recall a basic greeting. No pronunciation or fluency score is produced.

exercises.hint: Cari perkataan yang digunakan apabila memulakan perbualan.
exercises.remediation: Baca semula: Hello atau Hi digunakan untuk memulakan sapaan.

source.attribution: Not for publication; rights and editorial review are pending.

exercises.prompt: Taipkan satu sapaan bahasa Inggeris untuk 'Hai'.

source.attribution: Not for publication; rights and editorial review are pending.

lessons.title: Share your name
lessons.description: Use a model sentence for a short introduction and closing.

exercises.prompt: Taip model ini: My name is Ana.
exercises.hint: Gunakan perkataan My, name, is, dan Ana.
exercises.remediation: Salin model dengan tanda noktah: My name is Ana.

source.attribution: Not for publication; rights and editorial review are pending.

exercises.hint: Ia digunakan apabila anda hendak beredar.
exercises.remediation: Baca semula: Goodbye atau Bye menutup perbualan.
